Which,Ⓒpron.Ⓓ(Relative) yat m. f. n. (yaH-yA-yat).
Ⓑ
 2 (Interrogative) kiM m. f. n. (kaH-kA-kiM); ‘w(hich) of two’ yatara, katara; ‘w(hich) of many’ yatama, katama; ‘w(hich)ever’ ex. by repeating (1).

While,Ⓒs.ⒹkzaRaH, muhUrtaH, kAlaH, samayaH; ‘for a w(hile)’ kaMcitkAlaM, kzaRaM; ‘after a long w(hile)’ cireRa; ‘not worth w(hile)’ nizPala, nirarTaka, na upayukta; ‘worth w(hile)’ upayukta.
Ⓔconj.ⒹWhilst, yadA, yAvat (followed by tAvat); gen. by pres. part.; grAmaM gacCaMstfRaM spfSati ‘w(hile) going’ &c.
Ⓔv. t.Ⓓ(away) kzip 6 P, gam c., hf 1 P, vinud.

Whim,Ⓒs.ⒹkAmacAraH, kAmavftti f., CaMdaH, CaMdas n., cApalyaM, manolOlyaM, laharI, cittataraMgaH; ‘at oneʼs w(him)’ svacCaMdena, svecCayA; ‘acting according to anotherʼs w(him)’ CaMdonuvftti f.
ⓃWhimsical,Ⓒa.ⒹkAmacArin, svErin, svEra, svacCaMdAnuvartin, svacCaMda; capala, lola, anavasTita.
Whimper,Ⓒv. i.ⒹbAlakavat rud 2 P or kraMd 1 P.

Whip,Ⓒs.ⒹkaSA-zA, pratodaH, pratizkazaH-SaH.
Ⓔv. t.ⒹkaSayA pra-hf 1 P or taq 10 or cud 10 or daMq 10 or Ahan 2 U.
Ⓝ[Whip]ping,Ⓒs.ⒹkaSAGAtaH-tAqanaM-prahAraH; ‘deserving w(hipping)’ kaSya, kaSArha.

Whirl,Ⓒv. i.ⒹGUrR 6 P, 1 A, pari-, Bram 1, 4 P.
Ⓔv. t.ⒹGUrR c., Bram c. (Bramayati).
Ⓝ[Whirl]ing,Ⓒs.ⒹBramaRaM, GUrRanaM, Brami f.; Avftti f.; ‘w(hirl)-pool’ AvartaH, BramiH, BramaH, jalAvartaH, jalagulmaH, ‘w(hirl)-wind’ cakravAtaH, vAtAvartaH; vAtyA, vAtaBramaH.

Whisk,Ⓒv. t.ⒹatiSIGraM cal c. or vikzip 6 P.
Ⓔs.ⒹlaGukzepaH.
Ⓑ
 2 cAmaraM (for flies).

Whisper,Ⓒv.ⒹnIcEH-upAMSu-vad 1 P; karRe jap 1 P or kaT 10 or KyA 2 P; karRe upajap; ‘w(hisper) aside’ janAMtikaM vad.
Ⓝ[Whisper]ing,Ⓒs.ⒹkarRevAdaH, upAMSuvAdaH, karRejapaH; japaH-panaM; ‘in a w(hispering)’ upAMSu, janAMtikaM, nIcasvareRa.
Ⓝ[Whisper]er,Ⓒs.ⒹkarRe(rRa)japaH-kaTakaH.
Whit,Ⓒs.ⒹleSaH, lavaH, gaMDaH, aRuH; ‘not a w(hit)’ na manAgapi, na stokamapi, nAlpamapi.

White,Ⓒa.ⒹSukla, Sveta, Davala, SuBra, sita, gOra (rI f.), Suci, avadAta, viSada; DOta, pAMqura, avimala.
Ⓔs.ⒹSvetavarRaH, SuklavarRaH, SuklaH; SvetaH, sitaH, &c.; ‘dressed in w(hite)’ SvetavAMso daDAna.
Ⓝ[Whit]en,Ⓒv. t.ⒹDavalIkf 8 U, Davalayati (D.) &c.
Ⓔv. i.ⒹDavalIBU 1 P, DavalAyate (D.).
Ⓝ[Whit]ish,Ⓒa.ⒹApAMqu.
Ⓝ[White]ness,Ⓒs.ⒹSuklatA, DAvalyaM, SuBratA, Davaliman, Sukliman m.
ⓃWhite-wash,Ⓒv. t.ⒹsuDayA lip 6 P or DavalIkf; ‘a house w(hite-wash)ed’ suDABavanaM.
Ⓔs.ⒹsuDA, suDAlepaH.
ⓃWhites,Ⓒs.ⒹSvetapradaraH.
